test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Identify the option that arranges the given events in the correct sequence of their occurence.**

A. King Sagara’s sons were burnt by sage Kapila.

B. King Bhagiratha persuaded Ganga to flow to the earth.

C. King Sagara performed an ashwamedha yagna.

D. The souls of the dead sons would not get salvation until Ganga flowed over their ashes.

E. However, the flow had to be restrained by Shiva by holding it in his locks.
solution:
The correct answer is: **CADBE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let us see the correct sequence of the events.

__
 
• King Sagara performed an Ashwamedha yagna (**C**).
 
• King Sagara's sons were burnt by sage Kapila (**A**).
 
• The souls of the dead sons would not get salvation until Ganga flowed over their ashes (**D**).
 
• King Bhagiratha persuaded Ganga to flow to the earth (**B**).
 
• However, the flow had to be restrained by Shiva by holding it in his locks (**E**).

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• (**CAEDB**) - The events are not in the correct chronological order.
 
• (**ACEBD**) - The events are not in the correct chronological order.
 
• (**ADCBE**) - The events are not in the correct chronological order.
